record.paper_title: Open Problems on Configuration Spaces of Tensegrities
record.context_brief: Higher-codimension strata not built from codimension one
record.original_question: Find all strata of codimension greater than 1 that cannot be obtained as intersections of closures of several codimension-1 strata in the configuration-space stratification of tensegrities.

evidence.quote: A stratum is by definition a maximal connected component of B_d(G) with equivalent fibers.
Problem 5 Find all strata of codimension more than 1 that are not defined as an intersection of the closure of several codimension 1 strata.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a graph with vertex set $\{1,\dots,n\}$ and let $d\ge 2$. For a configuration $p=(p_1,\dots,p_n)\in(\mathbb{R}^d)^n$, a self-stress on $(G,p)$ is an assignment of real weights $w_{ij}$ to the edges $\{i,j\}$ of $G$ such that for every vertex $i$,
$$\sum_{j:\{i,j\}\in E(G)} w_{ij}(p_j-p_i)=0.$$
The space of self-stresses on $(G,p)$ forms a real vector space whose dimension depends on $p$. Let $B_d(G)\subset(\mathbb{R}^d)^n$ denote the configuration space of $n$-tuples, equipped with the stratification whose strata are the maximal connected subsets on which the self-stress fiber (i.e. the space of self-stresses, viewed up to a natural equivalence of fibers) is constant. A codimension-1 stratum is one whose codimension in $(\mathbb{R}^d)^n$ equals 1.

Problem. Determine all strata of this stratification whose codimension exceeds 1 and which cannot be expressed as a connected component of an intersection of closures of finitely many codimension-1 strata.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed among the open problems concerning the stratification of configuration spaces of tensegrities. Searches indicate that while codimension-1 strata have been studied (including Cayley-algebra style descriptions in the planar case) and individual high-codimension cases have been described for small n, no general classification of higher-codimension strata that fail to arise as intersections of closures of codimension-1 strata has been published. The status appears to still be open.

status_evidence.snippet: Foundational work on the stratification of B_d(G) by self-stress fibers, treating codimension-1 strata in detail.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational results address codimension-1 strata, while higher-codimension strata not generated by them remain unclassified.
